purpose: Editorially selected Signals candidates for the Sunday 20 September 2026 edition. The choices favour specific, primary-source developments that change an operating condition, market-access requirement or evidence demand; routine provider-status notices and minor enforcement updates were not promoted.

topics.editorialRationale: Select Anthropic's embedded-evaluation partnership because it makes assurance an access-and-independence question. Independent evaluators need enough visibility into development, safeguards and real use to challenge a provider's evidence rather than merely review a public statement.

Select the SEC innovation exemption. It puts conditions such as rights equivalence, issuer notice, auditable smart contracts, trading-halt alignment and public disclosure inside a live route to market, rather than treating tokenisation as a generic innovation theme.

No fresh third-party candidate cleared the materiality threshold. The available notices were resolved or limited provider-status incidents. Retain the BIS third-party-dependence item as a reviewed continuing priority rather than elevate raw operational status copy.

Select OSFI's 2027 market-risk chapter because it supplies an implementation timetable and a detailed evidence demand for capital, model and data control. It is stronger than the week's support-portal outages, which do not establish a material resilience implication for readers.

No fresh financial-crime candidate cleared the threshold. The available cases were individual enforcement or public-warning notices rather than a development that changes a firm-wide control decision; retain reviewed material.

Select CISA's two newly catalogued exploited vulnerabilities. The signal is not the alert itself; it is whether a firm can identify exposure and evidence emergency remediation against the estate quickly enough to make its vulnerability process credible.

No new technology-failure notice cleared the materiality threshold. The Cloudflare and GitHub items were limited or resolved provider incidents; retain the reviewed dependency records rather than elevate raw operational status copy.

No fresh data candidate cleared the threshold. The available publications did not add a concrete operating requirement beyond the existing reviewed data-role and retention material; retain reviewed records.
